ecofeminist theory and movement, as a part of the feminist movement, is a relevant factor in the process of shifting the concept of environmental securtiy towards the concept that includes gender equality and the rights of women as a vulnerable group.

the ecofeminism, as a movement that aims to empower women, has the potential to contribute to a better understanding of the gender dimension of environmental security and thus to a more efficient approach to environmental security as a whole.
